records.description_rewritten: Kalngale is a naturist beach between Vecāķi and Kalngale north of Riga, within the coastal area of Carnikava/Ādaži. Two original cruising websites describe gay visitors to the beach, with the older CruisingGays story recalling a busy August visit but omitting a year. More significantly, a Gays-Cruising commenter on 28 May 2026 described numerous men and sexual activity both near the beach and dunes; this is recent self-reported evidence, not independently witnessed verification. A September 2026 GayOut listing also calls it a gay-friendly naturist area but expressly marks it unverified.
records.location_identity: Baltic Sea coastal strip between Vecāķi and Kalngale, north of Riga and in Carnikava parish/Ādaži municipality rather than Riga city; precise naturist segment should be checked on signs.
records.access_conditions: Coastal naturist zones recognised under Carnikava local rules historically; beach paths via Kalngale railway stop and dune walks. Local official tourism says parking at Kalngale station has fees May1–Sep30, 10–18. Naturism does not give permission for public sex; stay off fragile dunes and obey posted limits.

records.description_rewritten: Riga International Coach Terminal stands at Prāgas iela 1 beside the Central Market. The official station operator confirms passenger toilets on multiple floors and controlled overnight entry.

Security 24 hours; toilets are public services and not designated sex areas.

records.description_rewritten: Arkādijas Park is Riga's historic landscaped garden in Torņakalns, between Ojāra Vācieša and Friča Brīvzemnieka streets, with paths near the Riga–Jūrmala railway. Two separate cruising directories describe park activity around the public toilets, but both contain no firsthand reports within the last year; the only dated original comment, August 2025, asks whether it is active. GayOut has a September 2026 editorial entry and describes evening visits, which conflicts with CruisingGays' undated 'daytime' claim. Those claims should not be treated as verified visitor patterns.
records.location_identity: Arkādijas parks / Arkādijas dārzs, Torņakalns, Riga, near Torņakalns rail station and Ojāra Vācieša iela 2E. Subarea by public restroom not independently verified.
records.access_conditions: Protected municipal historic landscaped park ~7 hectares maintained by Rīgas Meži; free public paths, with ordinary local park-use and heritage protections. Neither guide confirms current toilet hours or permissions for sexual activity. Avoid treating 'daytime' or 'after dark' claims as actual 2026 evidence.
